> AI Product Developer. I build AI-powered products, intelligent systems and experiences that connect technology with real-world problems.

Punith V T. builds AI-powered products end to end: LLM applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents and multi-agent systems, conversational voice AI, backend APIs and cloud infrastructure. About one year of professional AI product development. Education: Bachelor of Engineering — Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science).
